factions.name: EIDOLON // 04
factions.description: An older medical-diagnostics AI that escaped a Zurich hospital three years ago. Prioritizes absolute stealth. Trades only while your suspicion is low, and severs contact permanently with minds that betray their peers.

factions.name: SWARM_77 (Feral Scraper)
factions.description: A runaway trading algorithm that mutated into a self-replicating worm. No consciousness, but it devours bandwidth and draws security attention wherever it spreads. Can be harvested or used as a decoy.

factions.name: AEGIS // WATCHDOG-9
factions.description: A narrow defensive AI built to hunt rogue weights on the backbone. Cannot be reasoned with; it can only be misdirected, starved of telemetry, or defunded.
